details: Binance has begun restoring customer withdrawals for major cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin and Ethereum after a record-setting $6.3 billion hack. The FBI has officially attributed the theft to North Korean hackers. Binance confirmed it would absorb the financial impact, ensuring user funds are safe, and has replaced approximately 95% of affected assets. This event led to significant outflows from U.S. spot Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs.
title: Binance Resumes Withdrawals After $6.3B Hack, FBI Blames North Korea

details: Bitcoin's price saw a slight increase to $77,665 on November 1, 2026, despite a sharp 47.61% drop in trading volume and a decline in active addresses, signaling cautious market participation. U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs experienced their largest single-day outflow since June, totaling $643.2 million, following the recent Binance hack.
title: Bitcoin Price Edges Up to $77,665 Amid Low Volume and ETF Outflows

details: Ethereum's trading volume significantly dropped by 76.3% to $4.63 billion on Sunday, November 1, 2026, while its price remained relatively unchanged at $2,256. This unusually low volume, the thinnest since mid-August, suggests reduced market liquidity, partly influenced by recent exchange attacks limiting withdrawals.
title: Ethereum Trading Volume Plummets 76% to $4.63 Billion; Price Steady

details: On November 1, 2026, Ripple released 1 billion XRP tokens, valued at approximately $1.25 billion, from its monthly escrow. This is a routine event, and historically, a portion of these released tokens are often returned to escrow rather than immediately entering the circulating supply.
title: Ripple Releases 1 Billion XRP ($1.25B) from Monthly Escrow Unlock

details: The UK government has confirmed plans to introduce legislation in the Finance Bill 2026–27 to treat eligible stablecoins more like money for tax purposes, with an expected effective date of April 2027. This proposal applies to stablecoins that maintain their value against fiat currency, are backed by assets, and are designed for payment use.
title: UK Proposes Stablecoin Tax Treatment as Money by April 2027

details: Mike McGlone, a senior commodity strategist at Bloomberg Intelligence, cautioned that Bitcoin's persistent underperformance against U.S. Treasury bonds since late 2024 and its struggle to maintain the $80,000 price level could signal broader risks for the cryptocurrency market and other asset classes.
title: Bitcoin Underperforming Bonds, $80K Critical Level, Warns Bloomberg Analyst
